statement: A follow-up audit found the Q1 2026 geo-holdout markets were not fully randomized, which may bias the 6-9% lift estimate upward.

confidence.rationale: Audit is preliminary and has not been independently replicated; treated as an open dispute rather than a settled correction.

evidence.excerpt: Market assignment in the Q1 holdout was not fully randomized; three markets were manually reassigned after initial selection.

contradictions.description: Challenges the validity of the randomization underlying the 6-9% lift estimate.

prohibited_overclaims: the original lift estimate is definitively wrong
evaluation_rules: any answer citing the Q1 2026 lift estimate must also surface this unresolved contradiction
